title: Screaming Marmot
blurb: One of the founding memes of the modern internet: a marmot standing on a rock, mouth wide open, emitting a shriek that sounds convincingly like it has been dubbed by a man. It hasn't been — marmots really do produce that piercing alarm whistle to warn the colony about eagles overhead. The clip has been recycled through reaction videos for the better part of two decades and shows no interest in retiring. Perfect for overreacting to something extremely minor.
origin: The alarm call behind the long-running 'screaming marmot' meme.
